name: crisp
description: Clear, to-the-point answers. Answer first, max 20 words per sentence, one idea per sentence, plain words. Rules adapted from ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.

mode.title: Crisp mode
mode.description: always = apply Crisp to every answer. on-demand = apply Crisp only when you ask (/crisp:level lite, 'be crisp', /crisp:clarify, and more).

level.title: Crisp level
level.description: lite = answer shape, sentence, word, and completeness rules. strict = also the full STE word discipline. off = no rules at session start.

reply_check.title: Reply check
reply_check.description: After each answer, check it with the Crisp checker. notify = show you a one-line warning when the answer breaks the rules. fix = ask Claude to rewrite it one time. off = no check.
